subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Head in the clouds

options.text: Thinking about the sky and clouds

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Being impractical.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Head in the clouds"** refers to someone being impractical, daydreaming, or not paying attention to reality. It indicates a state of detachment from practical concerns or everyday matters. (हवा में होना या वास्तविकता से दूर होना)

 
 
• **Example:** She always has her head in the clouds, dreaming about becoming a famous artist, instead of focusing on her studies.
 
 
 
• The correct meaning of **"Being impractical"** aligns well with the idiom, as it signifies someone who is not grounded in reality or practical matters. (अव्यावहारिक होना)
 
 
• **Example:** His plan to travel the world without any money is completely impractical.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom **"Head in the clouds"** is best interpreted as **"Being impractical."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 2: Being punctual and sincere** (समय पर और ईमानदार होना): Refers to someone who is always on time and acts with sincerity.

 
 
• **Example:** He is known for being punctual and sincere in all his work commitments.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Working hard** (कड़ी मेहनत करना): Refers to someone who puts in a lot of effort and dedication into their tasks.
 
 
• **Example:** She has been working hard to prepare for her upcoming exams.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Thinking about the sky and clouds** (आकाश और बादलों के बारे में सोचना): This is a literal interpretation of the phrase, but it doesn't align with the idiom's meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** He spent the afternoon gazing at the sky and clouds, lost in thought.
 
 
 
• **Option 5: [Not provided in the data]**
